The '''Sphere of Expansion and Diplomacy''', also known as the '''Ministry of Expansion and Diplomacy''' and the '''Pyramid of Expansion and Diplomacy''', was one of twelve [[Spheres of Influence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Headed by a [[Dark Council]]or, the Sphere was responsible for the expansion of the Empire's borders and all diplomatic relations. The [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] answered to the head of the Sphere, a position that was filled by [[Darth Ravage]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

After the Empire's defeat at the hand of the [[Eternal Empire]], the sphere was combined with the [[Sphere of Imperial Intelligence]] into the [[Sphere of Galactic Influence]] by Empress [[Darth Acina]].<ref name="SOTG" />
